resources.name: Open-source DFT software (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, ABINIT, GPAW)

access.notes: Any open-source DFT code supporting GGA-PBE and spin-orbit coupling is acceptable.

resources.notes: The paper used VASP (proprietary); the task is rescoped to an open-source equivalent.

resources.name: Pseudopotential library for Nb, Ta, C (PBE PAW or norm-conserving)

access.notes: Standard repositories: PseudoDojo, GBRV, SSSP; provide PBE pseudopotentials for Nb, Ta, and C.

resources.notes: The agent must select pseudopotentials that reproduce the reported DFT trends within reasonable tolerances.
